from pathlib import Path
import fcntl,os,json,time,datetime
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;f=Path('<COORD_ROOT>/vllm_pd_workload.lock').open('a');fcntl.flock(f,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
t=time.monotonic()
def save(phase):
 p=R/'state.json';q=p.with_suffix('.tmp');q.write_text(json.dumps({'phase':phase,'pid':os.getpid(),'at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'bound_s':72000,'task':'sg_matched_workload_guard_g177'}));q.replace(p)
save('claimed')
while time.monotonic()-t<72000:
 if (R/'release.request').exists():save('released_by_root');break
 time.sleep(2)
else:save('expired')
